name: LangChain (Python, langchain-core) tools / ToolMessage

fields.name: function name by default; override with @tool("name"); snake_case recommended
fields.args_schema: Pydantic model or JSON schema; otherwise inferred from required type hints

tool_result.error: ToolMessage.status: Literal['success','error'] (default 'success'); docs pattern = middleware catches exception and returns ToolMessage(content='Tool failed: ...', tool_call_id=...). artifact: Any = None carries output NOT sent to the model.

schema_rules: LangChain imposes no documented name/schema restriction itself; the bound provider's rules apply when tools are converted (e.g. OpenAI 64-char names).
Every tool call in history needs a matching ToolMessage (tool_call_id).

sources.what: ToolMessage fields (tool_call_id, type, artifact, status) and ToolCall TypedDict

uncertain: 'Provider rules apply' is an inference, not a quoted LangChain statement.

check.why: 机器检查用：name 是导出后工具名要满足的正则（取各处文档里最严的那个），forbid_keys 是参数 schema 里不能出现的关键字；依据见 name_rule / schema_rules / sources
